method: Two complete sequential runs; seven alternating samples per path per run. All builds finished before timing. Allocation counts include reallocations and come from separate untimed passes.
limits: Shared Mac; warm local database reads; Rust allocation calls only, not SQLite C allocations or peak memory. Generated queue, peer, and GUI states use sampled Music descriptions. GUI kernels exclude window rendering. Results do not establish application latency.

sample.generated_states: Peer, queue, and GUI lifecycle states will be generated from sampled metadata.
